questions.question: What is the effect of threshold voltage drop in NMOS pass transistor logic circuits?

explanations.a: Correct. Threshold voltage drop in NMOS pass transistor logic causes the output logic high to be degraded, resulting in a lower than expected high level.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Output logic low is not degraded by threshold voltage drop; it remains close to ground.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Threshold voltage drop does impact output levels, especially logic high.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Threshold voltage drop does not improve noise immunity; it can worsen it.

questions.question: Which design technique can be used to mitigate threshold drop in pass transistor logic?

explanations.a: Correct. Using transmission gates (parallel NMOS and PMOS) can mitigate threshold drop and restore full logic levels.
explanations.b: Incorrect. Increasing supply voltage may help, but is not always practical or effective.
explanations.c: Incorrect. Decreasing transistor width does not mitigate threshold drop; it may worsen it.
explanations.d: Incorrect. Adding more NMOS transistors does not solve the threshold drop issue.
